summary: 游戏音频的引擎无关做法：总线布局、分贝音量滑条、响度、对话时压低音乐、自适应音乐和音效变化，附 Godot、Unity、FMOD/Wwise 对照。 Engine-neutral game audio technique: bus layout, volume sliders in decibels, loudness, ducking music under dialogue, adaptive music and SFX variation, with Godot, Unity and FMOD/Wwise mappings. Use when mixing a game, making music react to combat, fixing repetitive footsteps or beat sync, or a mix that clips or pumps. Not for the Godot audio API (`godot-audio`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill audio-design，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when mixing a game, making music react to combat, fixing repetitive footsteps or beat sync, or a mix that clips or pumps.
Workflow: Inventory first; Lay out buses; Map sliders to decibels; Set headroom and a loudness target.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
